principle: Cosmetic presentation only; Bountiful remains authoritative for objective and reward logic.

ccc_local_wheat.title: Grain for the Storehouse
ccc_local_wheat.body: The storehouse is buying clean wheat while there is still room in the bins.

regional_body.CORE: The storehouse is buying clean wheat while there is still room in the bins.
regional_body.NORTH: The colder road has made deliveries unreliable. The storehouse wants wheat put away before travel gets worse.
regional_body.EAST: Wet weather spoiled part of the grain stock. The storehouse is buying dry wheat before the next long rain.
regional_body.SOUTH: The last caravan arrived light. The storehouse wants grain in reserve before another dry-road delay.
regional_body.WEST: The market emptied the grain bins faster than expected. The storehouse is paying for a fresh supply.

ccc_local_logs.title: Timber for Repairs
ccc_local_logs.body: Fences, roofs, and carts all need repairs. The builder is buying sound timber.

regional_body.CORE: Fences, roofs, and carts all need repairs. The builder is buying sound timber.
regional_body.NORTH: Snow and wind have been hard on the outer roofs. The builder is buying sound timber for repairs.
regional_body.EAST: The damp has warped fencing and walkways again. The builder is buying straight, dry timber.
regional_body.SOUTH: Sun and dust have split several wagon frames. The builder is buying sound timber for repairs.
regional_body.WEST: Old fences and barn doors have finally given up. The builder is buying good timber before the next round of work.

ccc_local_wool.title: Wool for the Loom
ccc_local_wool.body: The loom-house is short on clean wool. It is ordinary work, but useful work.

regional_body.CORE: The loom-house is short on clean wool. It is ordinary work, but useful work.
regional_body.NORTH: The loom-house is short on wool just as the nights are getting colder. Clean bundles are worth good coin here.
regional_body.EAST: Too much of the stored wool took on damp. The weaver is paying for clean, dry bundles.
regional_body.SOUTH: Caravan cloth wears quickly in the dry country. The weaver is buying wool for blankets, wraps, and repairs.
regional_body.WEST: The autumn market cleaned out half the loom-house. The weaver is buying wool for the next run of blankets and cloth.

ccc_local_string.title: Cord and Canvas
ccc_local_string.body: Straps, sacks, and reins all seem to need repair at once. The caravan hands are buying string.

regional_body.CORE: Straps, sacks, and reins all seem to need repair at once. The caravan hands are buying string.
regional_body.NORTH: Pack straps have been snapping stiff in the cold. The caravan hands want spare cord before the next trip.
regional_body.EAST: Wet rope frays quickly in the green country. The caravan hands are buying dry string for repairs.
regional_body.SOUTH: Dust and long miles have worn through more straps than expected. The caravan hands need fresh cord.
regional_body.WEST: Harvest carts and grain sacks have used up the repair stock. The caravan hands are buying string.

ccc_local_zombie.title: Keep the Road Clear
ccc_local_zombie.body: Travelers have been having trouble on the road after dusk. The watch is paying for help.

regional_body.CORE: Travelers have been having trouble on the road after dusk. The watch is paying for help.
regional_body.NORTH: Night patrols have been finding more trouble along the cold road. The watch wants the route safer before travelers get stranded.
regional_body.EAST: The wet roadside has become difficult after dusk. The watch is paying to make the path safer again.
regional_body.SOUTH: The open dry road has become risky after sunset. The watch is paying for help keeping it passable.
regional_body.WEST: The old road has become unreliable after dark. The watch wants travelers able to reach the village safely.

ccc_local_skeleton.title: Arrows in the Dark
ccc_local_skeleton.body: The watch has found too many stray arrows along the road and wants the problem reduced.

regional_body.CORE: The watch has found too many stray arrows along the road and wants the problem reduced.
regional_body.NORTH: Arrows keep turning up in the snowbanks beside the road. The watch wants the route safer before the next night patrol.
regional_body.EAST: The brush along the road is giving archers too much cover. The watch is paying to make the route safer.
regional_body.SOUTH: The open road offers travelers very little shelter. The watch wants the danger reduced before another caravan leaves.
regional_body.WEST: Old stone walls beside the road have made the route troublesome after dark. The watch is paying for help.

ccc_local_spider.title: Webs Near the Fields
ccc_local_spider.body: Too many webs have appeared near the fields. The farmers are paying for help before livestock wanders into them.

regional_body.CORE: Too many webs have appeared near the fields. The farmers are paying for help before livestock wanders into them.
regional_body.NORTH: Webs are appearing between the spruce trunks near the grazing path. The farmers want the route usable again.
regional_body.EAST: The garden edge has been webbed over twice this week. The farmers are paying for help before more crops are lost.
regional_body.SOUTH: Webs have started appearing under the dry walls around the fields. The farmers want the pens kept clear.
regional_body.WEST: The hedges and old fence corners are filling with webs. The farmers want them cleared before livestock gets tangled.
